headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 3, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing an 8-0 victory. Tim Mayza earned the win after pitching effectively in relief. The Washington Nationals fell short in Atlanta, dropping a 2-4 decision to the Braves. Mike Yastrzemski led the Nationals with a home run and two RBIs, but it wasn't enough to secure a win. The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 5-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Jordan Walker leading the offense.

Several players have been affected by injuries, impacting their team's availability. Connor Seabold has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right lat strain with the Kansas City Royals. PJ Poulin has also been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with a left flexor strain for the Washington Nationals. Jake Fraley has been placed on the 60-day injured list with a hernia for the Tampa Bay Rays. Lenyn Sosa has been placed on the 60-day injured list with a right wrist contusion for the Toronto Blue Jays.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Atlanta Braves acquired right-handed pitcher Tyler Uberstine in a trade, while the Boston Red Sox traded RF Eli White to the Braves for Uberstine. The Chicago Cubs acquired RHP Ryan Zeferjahn from the Los Angeles Angels in exchange for C Moisés Ballesteros and RHP Mason McGwire. The Toronto Blue Jays traded CF Daulton Varsho and cash to the Houston Astros for RHP Spencer Arrighetti.

top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing an 8-0 victory. Tim Mayza earned the win after pitching effectively in relief.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Atlanta**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 2-4 decision to the Atlanta Braves, unable to overcome a strong Braves performance. Mike Yastrzemski led the Nationals with a home run and two RBIs, but it wasn't enough to secure a win.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Blue Jays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 5-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Jordan Walker leading the offense. Walker collected 2 hits, 2 RBIs, and was instrumental in a key play that saw Blaze Jordan and Lars Nootbaar score.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Fall to Guardians in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians dominated the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-0, securing a shutout victory. Patrick Bailey led the Diamondbacks with a home run and an RBI, while Gavin Williams pitched 5.2 innings, striking out 10 batters without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Royals Roster Update: Seabold Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right lat strain.

top_news.title: **Braves Acquire RHP Tyler Uberstine in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Tyler Uberstine in a trade. Uberstine joins the Braves after being dealt from the Boston Red Sox.
